title: Rune Construction authority and boundary matrix

authority_levels.meaning: Direct retained-source statement or structured source record.
Owner-approved design objective recorded in current governance; not automatically a detailed mechanic.
Implementation/planning organization derived from source and owner intent; not canonical game content by itself.
Mechanic requiring later governed design, validation and acceptance.

owned_by_ppia07: Rune atom model and rune-system composition semantics
Rune construction reference cases and acceptance/balance material

consumes_without_redefining.domain: Core spellcasting, mana, resistance, counterspell, fatigue, Overreach
consumes_without_redefining.rule: Use as context and explicit integration points; do not silently copy every value into the rune system.
Use as direct precedent for modular modification, glyph/logic structures, sequencing, triggers and resonance; do not equate these objects with runes without governed design.
Preserve explicit rune-carving and enchanting mechanics where applicable; do not infer missing atom or connection semantics.
May supply effect-domain references; spells are not automatically rune atoms.

consumes_without_redefining.domain: Charge holders and magical item containers
consumes_without_redefining.rule: May host/link rune constructions; item Definition/instance ownership remains PPIA-03.

cross_domain_routes.responsibility: Item/equipment/inventory Definition and instance semantics; PPIA-07 owns only rune/enchantment extension data attached to those objects.
Campaign/Scene runtime instantiation and current state for placed rune objects/effects.
Encounter/balance calibration methodology; PPIA-07 supplies rune benchmarks but must not claim guaranteed balance.
World/setting-local rule scope; rune rules do not universalize setting-local magic without explicit authority.
Permission/reveal filtering before hidden rune facts enter search, summaries, exports, diagnostics or AI context.
Recovery/idempotency patterns for authoritative rune-authoring mutations.
Crafting Hub/Workbench/Enchanting & Enhancement interface conventions including rune/ingredient selection, compatibility, predicted effects, risks, stability, provenance, autosave and accessibility.

guardrails: Unknown source mechanics stay unknown; foundation gaps become explicit future design work.
Do not auto-generate a rune atom catalog from spell names, magic schools, item names, symbols, glyph names or thematic similarity.
Do not treat co-occurrence of runes, sigils, scripts, glyphs and macros as identity equivalence.
Do not silently resolve the Scripts & Macros progression conflict.
No broad offline authoritative rune mutation is permitted.
AI suggestions and random/generated constructions remain proposals until explicitly accepted and provenance-recorded.
Every visual topology/shape operation requires an equivalent ordered textual/nonvisual representation.
Authoritative mutations require expected-version and operation-id/idempotent recovery behavior.
next_design_questions: What is the minimal reusable rune atom vocabulary?
Which connection types exist and what does each mean?
Which shaping modifiers are distinct from target/range/area modifiers?
What grammar makes valid/invalid constructions deterministic?
Which costs are structural, which are payload-derived, and which are execution-context dependent?
How do resonance/risk and counterplay scale with composition complexity?
